title: OriginalSalienceCaptureLimits
description: Logical input/master/moment caps, not parser, tape, filesystem or full RSS admission.

max_asset_bytes.description: Complete raw asset payload cap for actual source observation.

max_dense_bytes.description: Aggregate retained widened f32 master bytes.

max_moment_bytes.description: Aggregate retained raw f64 moment-vector bytes.

max_source_bytes.description: Complete raw tensor payload cap for actual source observation.

max_text_bytes.description: Aggregate exact UTF-8 text bytes; zero for token-ID input.

max_tokenizer_config_bytes.description: Actual tokenizer_config.json bytes; zero for token-ID input.

max_total_tokens.description: Aggregate executed tokens/rows, without shared-consumer multiplication.

max_window_tokens.description: Every token in one context, including its final token.
